metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - Catches one pass
metadata.description: Schoonmaker finished with one catch for 12 yards in Sunday's 28-20 loss to the Giants.
metadata.analysis: The tight end played on 13 of 58 offensive snaps and 10 more on special teams. Schoonmaker, now in his fourth NFL season, has 50 career catches in the regular season.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker (personal) misses practice Thursday
metadata.description: Luke Schoonmaker (personal) missed Dallas' practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Schoonmaker was absent from practice on Thursday due to what is being described as a personal issue of some kind. We should get more clarity regarding his status for Week 1 sometime after Friday's practice.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - Disappointing season in 2025
metadata.description: Schoonmaker caught 14 of 23 targets for 132 yards and zero touchdowns over 17 games for the Cowboys in 2025.
metadata.analysis: The 2023 second-round pick has yet to miss a game in the NFL career, but Schoonmaker has done little else of note. His receiving numbers took a tumble from the 27-241-1 line he posted in 2024, and undrafted second-year player Brevyn Spann-Ford has moved past him on the depth chart due to his superior run blocking, although neither player is a threat to starting TE Jake Ferguson. Schoonmaker has one more year left on his rookie contract, but he hasn't done much to secure a spot in the Cowboys' long-term plans.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker catches two passes in Week 17
metadata.description: Luke Schoonmaker caught both of his targets for 15 yards in the Cowboys' 30-23 win over the Commanders in Week 17.
metadata.analysis: Schoonmaker remains an afterthought in the Dallas offense, recording two targets or less in each of his last eight games. The tight ends could be in line for an increased workload if Jake Ferguson (calf) is unable to suit up in Week 18 against the New York Giants.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker catches only target in Week 13
metadata.description: Luke Schoonmaker caught his only target for one yard in the Cowboys' 31-28 win over the Chiefs in Week 13.
metadata.analysis: Schoonmaker remains minimally involved in the Dallas offense, finishing with less than three targets in 11 of 12 games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 14 contest against the Detroit Lions.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - No targets in Week 11 win
metadata.description: Schoonmaker went without a target while playing 30 of the Cowboys' 67 snaps on offense in Monday's 33-16 win over the Raiders.
metadata.analysis: Schoonmaker ran routes on just six of his 30 snaps and was one of the few Dallas pass catchers to go without a look on a night in which quarterback Dak Prescott targeted nine different players. So as long as top tight end Jake Ferguson is available, Schoonmaker looks like he'll mostly be limited to a tertiary role in the passing game while serving as a blocker more often than not when he's on the field.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - Season-high three targets Sunday
metadata.description: Schoonmaker caught two of his three targets for 25 yards in Sunday's loss to the Broncos.
metadata.analysis: The Cowboys curiously went away from Jake Ferguson in the contest as a receiving option, and as a result Schoonmaker saw a season-high three targets while also reaching double-digit receiving yards for the first time in 2025. The production wasn't much, but it's at least a positive sign for the third-year tight end. If Ferguson's disappearance from the game plan proves to be more than just a one-week trend, Schoonmaker could benefit.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - No targets in Week 7 win
metadata.description: Schoonmaker went without a target while playing 22 of the Cowboys' 67 offensive snaps in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Commanders.
metadata.analysis: Though quarterback Dak Prescott spread the ball around to eight different pass catchers in Sunday's romp, Schoonmaker didn't get in on the act. The third-year tight end had drawn at least one target in each of Dallas' first six games, accruing a 5-24-0 receiving line over that stretch.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - Shut out as receiver Sunday
metadata.description: Schoonmaker failed to catch two targets in Sunday's 40-37 overtime win over the Giants.
metadata.analysis: The 2023 second-round pick is still looking for his first catch of the season, whiffing on all three of his targets while Jake Ferguson dominates the receiving opportunities at tight end for Dallas. Even Schoonmaker's hold on the No. 2 spot on the depth chart could be slipping, as Brevyn Spann-Ford is proving to be a better blocker and caught his only target Sunday, albeit for just three yards.

metadata.title: Luke Schoonmaker - Just one target Thursday
metadata.description: Schoonmaker failed to catch his only target in Thursday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: The third-year tight end had a limited role, as expected, while working behind starter Jake Ferguson. Schoonmaker's hold on the No. 2 spot on the depth chart may not be secure, either, despite his standing as a 2023 second-round pick -- he played 15 snaps on offense to Brevyn Spann-Ford's 10, and the latter made a more noticeable impact with his blocking.
